defs.def: without any other people 独自

ex.s: And he’s not alone.
ex.t: 而且不止他一个人。

ex.s: You’ll find yourself virtually alone, or close to it.
ex.t: 你会发现自己几乎独自一人，或者接近如此。

ex.s: Eating alone, especially in front of the TV or computer, often leads to mindless overeating.
ex.t: 独自进食，尤其是在电视或电脑前，往往导致无意识的暴饮暴食。

ex.s: Take an examination alone.
ex.t: 独自参加考试。

ex.s: All the different hallways and rooms were too much to think about, let alone commit to memory.
ex.t: 所有的走廊和房间各不相同，多到让人难以想象，更别说记在心里。

ex.s: He enjoyed being alone.
ex.t: 他喜欢独处。

ex.s: Exploring the place alone.
ex.t: 独自探索这个地方。

ex.s: In the experiment, Goffin’s cockatoos were able to select the right tool for the job, in most cases, by visual recognition alone.
ex.t: 在实验中，Goffin的cockatoos能够选择合适的工作工具，在大多数情况下仅通过视觉识别。

ex.s: And I wanted to do it alone as I always prefer it that way.”
ex.t: 我想独自去，因为我一直更喜欢那样。"

ex.s: It is calculated that European railways alone spend approximately 20 billion euros a year on maintenance, including sending maintenance staff, often at night, to inspect and repair the rail infrastructure.
ex.t: 这可能是危险的工作，如果有无人机协助工作人员就可以避免这种危险。

ex.s: ·Don’t rely on technology alone
ex.t: 记住重要日期

ex.s: It's a call she must heed alone, though.
ex.t: 不过，这是她必须独自听从的召唤。

ex.s: “People from cultures that value relationships more than ours does are shocked by the thought of eating alone in front of a computer”, says Art Markman, a professor of psychology at the University of Texas, Austin.
ex.t: "来自比我们更重视人际关系的文化背景的人会对在电脑前独自吃饭的想法感到震惊，"德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校心理学教授Art Markman说。

ex.s: Crystal knew that visions alone don’t produce results, but concluded that “we’ll never produce results that we can’t envision”.
ex.t: Crystal知道仅靠愿景不会产生成果，但她得出结论："我们永远无法产生我们无法设想的成果"。

ex.s: That movie led him into the second half of his career where his comedic presence alone could make a movie a financial success even when movie reviewers would not rate it highly.
ex.t: 那部电影将他带入了职业生涯的下半场，在那个阶段，仅凭他的喜剧魅力就能让一部电影在商业上获得成功，即使影评人评价不高。

ex.s: They are not alone.
ex.t: 他们并不孤单。

ex.s: Passion alone does not ensure a person's success.
ex.t: 光有热情并不能保证一个人的成功。

ex.s: Working this way for one year was painful enough, let alone a lifetime.
ex.t: 这样工作一年都足够痛苦了，更别提一辈子。

ex.s: And I know that I'm not alone.
ex.t: 我不再感到羞耻了。

ex.s: A new report found 46 percent of meals are eaten alone in America.
ex.t: 一份新报告发现，美国有46%的餐食是独自吃的。

ex.s: More than half（53 percent）have breakfast alone and nearly half（46 percent）have lunch by themselves.
ex.t: 超过一半（53%）的人独自吃早餐，近半数（46%）的人独自吃午餐。

ex.s: Alone，but together，you know？”Bechtel said，looking up from her book.
ex.t: “你明白的，虽然独自一人，但也在一起。”Bechtel从书本上抬起头来说。

ex.s: That freedom to choose is one reason more people like to eat alone.
ex.t: 选择自由是越来越多的人喜欢独自就餐的一个原因。

ex.s: The trend of having meals alone.
ex.t: 独自就餐的趋势。

ex.s: Africa 2,400; and Asia and the Pacific perhaps 3,200, of which Papua New Guinea alone accounts for well over 800.
ex.t: 非洲2400种；亚洲和太平洋或许3200种，其中仅巴布亚新几内亚就占了800多种。

ex.s: Then I got to the point where I was  45  really late at night to get my work alone.
ex.t: 然后我到了____45____深夜独自完成工作的地步。

ex.s: But size alone is not a crime.
ex.t: 但规模本身并非罪过。

ex.s: leave carbon emission aloneD. fight against carbon pollution
ex.t: 对碳排放放任自流D. 对抗碳污染

ex.s: Unfortunately, that plan seems unlikely to work: we have yet to invent a firewall that is secure against ordinary humans, let alone super intelligent machines.
ex.t: 可惜，那个计划似乎不太可能奏效：我们至今还没发明出一种能挡住普通人的防火墙，更别说超级智能机器了。

ex.s: Soon, I found that I was not alone - I came across other runners in the same area running for the same purpose!
ex.t: 很快，我发现我不是一个人——我在同一区域遇到了其他为同样目的跑步的人！

ex.s: It’s been a week since the other astronauts left Mars and went back to Earth, accidentally leaving me here alone.
ex.t: 自从其他宇航员离开火星回到地球一周后，不小心把我一个人留在这里。

ex.s: The Longji Rice Terraces were built by the local Zhuang ethnic group alone.
ex.t: 龙脊梯田是当地壮族独自建造的。

ex.s: From childhood on my heart and soul have been full of kindness, but for six years now, I have been forced to remove myself from society, to live life alone.
ex.t: 从童年开始，我的内心和灵魂就充满了善意，但六年来，我被迫脱离社会，独自生活。

ex.s: Phil Blythe explains: “For many older people, particularly those living alone or in the country, driving is important for preserving their independence, giving them the freedom to get out and about without having to rely on others.”
ex.t: 菲尔·布莱斯解释道：“对许多老年人来说，特别是那些独居或在乡村生活的人来说，驾驶对于保持独立性非常重要，让他们能够自由出行而不必依赖他人。”

defs.def: without the help of other people or things 独力；单独

ex.s: Then they were left alone in the room.
ex.t: 然后他们被单独留在那个房间里。

ex.s: He wasn't mean or abusive; he just gave me the impression he could do whatever project we dreamed up better if he did it alone.
ex.t: 他不是恶毒或虐待；他只是给我一个印象，他可以做我们梦想中更好的项目，如果他单独做的话。

defs.def: lonely and unhappy or without any friends 孤苦伶仃；无依无靠；孤独；寂寞
（用于名词或代词后）唯一，只有

ex.s: If you want to tell the history of the whole world, a history that does not privilege one part of humanity, you cannot do it through texts alone, because only some of the world has ever had texts, while most of the world, for most of the time, has not.
ex.t: 如果你想讲述整个世界的历史，一部不偏袒任何一部分人类的历史，你就不能只依靠文字文献，因为世界上只有一部分地区曾经有过文字，而世界上大部分地区在大部分时间里都没有。

defs.def: （用于名词或代词后以加强语气）仅仅，单，只

ex.s: But the opposite happened: She was flooded, shipping out 1,200 orders in June of 2020 alone.
ex.t: 但情况恰恰相反：她订单爆满，仅2020年6月就发出了1200份订单。

ex.s: I wasn't alone any longer.
ex.t: 我不再孤单了。

ex.s: And like more Americans, she’s not alone.
ex.t: 和越来越多的美国人一样，她并不孤单。

ex.s: “It doesn't feel as alone as it may have before al the advances in technology,” said Laurie Demerit， whose company provided the statistics for the report.
ex.t: "随着技术的进步，这不像以前那样让人觉得孤单了，"劳里·德默里特说道，她的公司为这份报告提供了统计数据。

ex.s: Recent studies estimate that between 400 million and 1 billion birds die from window impacts each year in the US alone.
ex.t: 最近的研究估计，仅在美国，每年就有 4 亿到 10 亿只鸟死于窗户撞击。

defs.def: to be independent or not connected with other people, organizations or ideas 单独；独立
to be not near other objects or buildings 孤零零地矗立
